title: Value Stream Catalog Entry
description: Schema for entries in technehub-labs/dea-catalog-value-streams. Mirrors the dea-metamodel dea:ValueStream entity schema (proposed CR-MET-014: core template plus outcome, customer_ref, entry_criterion, exit_criterion, aggregated_capability_refs) and carries catalog extensions per the org-wide catalog repository standard (CR-CATALOG-STRUCT-01). Extended under CR-VS-07 with value stages (each linked to business capabilities and business processes), stream categorisation, explicit scope, cross-stream links, and measurement hooks; cross-catalog refs (capabilities:, processes:) are referential-integrity-checked against the sibling catalog repos.

id.description: Content-addressed catalog id (org-wide id system, dea-metaframework/docs/id-system.md section 2.5): prefix value-streams, slug, and a 6-character content-derived hash.

type.description: Every entry in this catalog is a dea:ValueStream by catalog scope (metamodel layer L3, building block L3-value-delivery).

definition.description: End-to-end scope of the stream: the value-creating activities and the capabilities/processes it spans.

metamodel_pin.description: Metamodel version this record's shape is pinned to.

value_stream_category.description: Classification of the stream along the BIZBOK-style operational / support / governance / development axis (SRC-001). Operational streams deliver value to external parties; support streams serve internal parties; governance streams discharge oversight; development streams build future operational capability.

industries.description: Industries the stream applies to, from the controlled vocabulary in classifications/industry-vocabulary.yaml (CR-VS-11).

organization_types.description: Organization types the stream applies to, from the controlled vocabulary.

specificity.description: generic = enterprise-generic chain (cross-industry); industry-specific = the chain is canonical primarily within its industries. Same-name chains in non-overlapping applicability sets are distinct by construction (CR-VS-11 method note).

applicability.description: Applicability dimension (CR-VS-11): which industries / organization types the stream is canonical for. Fixes the modeling gap where two streams differ only by industry context, and scopes the distinctness sweep by applicability class.

outcome.description: The value proposition delivered to the consumer at the end of the stream.

customer_ref.description: The actor or stakeholder served by the stream. Record-side companion to the dea:served-by inverse of dea:serves (cardinality 0..*). Ids resolve against the dea-catalog-actors id space (referential-integrity-checked when populated with an actors: id).

entry_criterion.description: The trigger condition that starts the stream.

exit_criterion.description: The condition that confirms value has been delivered.

includes.description: In-scope activities and concerns of the stream.

excludes.description: Explicitly out-of-scope concerns, each naming the neighbour concept that owns them (boundary discipline per the CR-VS-02/CR-VS-05 sweeps).

scope.description: Explicit inclusion/exclusion boundary of the stream, complementing the free-text definition.

value_stages.description: Ordered sequence of value stages composing the stream. Array order is flow order: stage i+1 follows stage i; the first stage implements entry_criterion and the last implements exit_criterion. Each stage is linked referentially to the business capabilities that enable it and the business processes that realize it.

definition.description: What happens in this stage and why it creates value.

entry_criterion.description: Condition that must hold for the stage to start (stage gate).

exit_criterion.description: Condition that confirms the stage is complete.

outcome.description: The increment of value the stage delivers to the served party.

customer_visible.description: Whether the stage is visible to the served party (true) or internal (false). Defaults to the stream-level served party when omitted.

capability_refs.description: Business capabilities enabling the stage. Ids resolve against the dea-catalog-business-capabilities id space (referential-integrity-checked).

process_refs.description: Business processes realizing the stage. Ids resolve against the dea-catalog-business-processes id space (referential-integrity-checked).

actor_refs.description: Actors participating in the stage (dea:flows-to partner role). Referential-integrity-checked against dea-catalog-actors when populated with an actors: id.

aggregated_capability_refs.description: Capabilities the stream spans (the union of the per-stage capability_refs). Record-side companion to dea:aggregates (source side, cardinality 0..*). Ids resolve against the dea-catalog-business-capabilities id space.

process_refs.description: Business processes realizing the stream as a whole (the union of the per-stage process_refs). Ids resolve against the dea-catalog-business-processes id space (referential-integrity-checked).

upstream_refs.description: Streams whose exit feeds this stream's entry. Entries reference sibling streams by slug (id minus namespace prefix and content hash) so that hash changes in the sibling record do not break referential integrity.

note.description: What crosses the boundary between the streams.

downstream_refs.description: Streams whose entry is fed by this stream's exit. Slug-based, as upstream_refs.

note.description: What crosses the boundary between the streams.

metrics.description: Performance metrics attached to the stream or its stages. Record-side companion to dea:measured-by; metric ids resolve against the dea-catalog-metrics id space when the metric is catalogued there (referential-integrity-checked).

definition.description: How the metric is computed and what good looks like.

applies_to_stage.description: Name of the value stage the metric measures; omit for stream-level metrics. Must match a value_stages[].name when present.

metric_ref.description: Catalogued PerformanceMetric id (dea-catalog-metrics) when one exists. Admits the org-wide metrics: namespace form and the sibling catalog's legacy dea:metric-* id form (CR-VS-08 §2.1); legacy refs are rewritten if the metrics catalog migrates to the org-wide id system.

external_references.description: Identifiers in external systems. Never a substitute for the OpenDEA id (E004).

sources.description: References to the evidence register / research artifacts backing admission.

relationships.description: Typed relationship instances per dea-metamodel CR-002 (typed, directed, versioned, provenance-aware).

relationship_type.description: ValueStream-relevant relationship types (CR-MET-014 audit): the catalog record sits on the target side of aggregates/serves/flows-to and the source side of measured-by, expressed here through their inverses plus measured-by.
